propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml each hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets, creating drift risk that requires a manual sync guard test
the monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml conflates lint/mypy/config-check/pre-commit with the os×py matrix, forcing them to run redundantly in every matrix permutation

extract the shared gate logic (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) into a reusable workflow_call (_build-and-test.yml) parameterized by gerrit-refspec, and delegate both callers to it so drift is impossible by construction

the five parity-test invariants (gate-sync, script-asymmetry, optionality-contract, precommit-branch-sensitivity, linter-redundancy) must survive the refactor by retargeting scans from the callers to the reusable and rewriting the copy-sync check as a delegation+content check

gerrit-verify's reusable-call job must remain named build-and-test with needs: [clear-vote, require-ticket], and the Verified vote must still fold its job conclusions via the existing im-open/workflow-conclusion mechanism
